title: A correction becomes valuable when it changes a tested process
text: The supplied analysis connects work traces to expert review, revised rules or tools, reuse and subsequent outcomes. It also treats a skill file as an operating asset with trigger conditions, permissions, expected output, tests and an escalation path—not merely a reusable prompt.
qualification: These implementation details are the corpus compiler’s analytical extension of Pearson’s essay, not a separately validated framework.
